summary: Frontend re-verification of the BirdLens BirdCallPlayer nested-Pressable fix on web preview @ 412x915. ALL 12 critical checks PASS. The fix (extracting BirdCallPlayer to a sibling <View> outside the parent PressableScale) is now structurally correct in (tabs)/index.tsx, popular-birds.tsx, birds-near-you.tsx, and category/[id].tsx. After restarting expo to clear Metro's stale bundle cache, the DOM confirms ZERO nested <button> elements on Home, /popular-birds, /birds-near-you, and /category/Songbirds, ZERO React hydration errors at runtime, and tapping the play button on any of the four screens no longer triggers parent navigation to /bird/{id}. The image/text region of each card still navigates correctly to /bird/northern-cardinal. The 9 regression flows from iteration_2 (popular-birds-all, birds-near-you-all, category drill-in, popular card → bird detail, back navigation, etc.) continue to work. Note: initial test run before expo restart showed the OLD nested-button DOM was still being served because Metro had cached the pre-fix bundle. After `supervisorctl restart expo`, the fresh bundle eliminated the nested structure entirely. NO new bugs introduced. The fix is VERIFIED.

critical_code_review_comments: Structurally correct fix verified: BirdCallPlayer now lives in a sibling <View> (e.g. styles.popFooter / styles.footer / styles.birdFooter / styles.rowFooter) at the same level as the parent PressableScale card, so the DOM tree no longer has <button data-testid='popular-bird-X'><button data-testid='popular-bird-play-X'></button></button>. Verified via document.querySelectorAll('button') walking up parentElement chain — zero hits across all four screens.

Belt-and-braces: BirdCallPlayer.onPress (src/components/BirdCallPlayer.tsx:101) now calls e.stopPropagation() + e.preventDefault() + e.nativeEvent.stopImmediatePropagation(). This is correct and harmless given the new structure; keeps the implementation defensive if a future caller ever re-nests the player.

The setTimeout(150) heuristic for player.play() after setAudioUrl (src/components/BirdCallPlayer.tsx:88) is still fragile and the same comment from iteration_2 applies — consider switching to a status.isLoaded effect-driven play() call. Not blocking.

rca_of_issue: RCA confirmed and resolved. Root cause: PressableScale renders react-native's <Pressable> which becomes a native <button> on react-native-web. Putting one PressableScale (BirdCallPlayer) inside another PressableScale's children produced a <button><button> tree, which (a) triggered React 19 hydration validation errors and (b) caused click events on the inner play button to bubble to the outer card button on web, navigating away instead of starting playback. Mitigation applied: each affected screen now wraps the card in a plain <View> parent and renders the PressableScale card and the BirdCallPlayer as TWO sibling children — one PressableScale renders to <button>, the BirdCallPlayer renders to a separate, sibling <button>. The DOM tree is now flat with no button-in-button. As an additional safety net, BirdCallPlayer.onPress also calls e.stopPropagation() + e.preventDefault(). Verification: nested-button DOM check returns [] on all four affected screens; play click does not change the URL and the parent screen remains visible; card/image click still navigates to /bird/{id}.
